Name: Image Segment Subheader
Description: The NITF image segment subheader defined in MIL-STD-2500C Section 5.4 and Table A-3. The fields contain information about the image structure, collection metadata, and geographic positioning.

IM.Name: File Part Type
IM.Description: This field shall contain the characters 'IM' to identify the subheader as an image subheader.

IID1.Name: Image Identifier 1
IID1.Description: The alphanumeric identification code associated with the image. The valid codes are determined by the application.

IDATIM.Name: Image Date and Time
IDATIM.Description: The time (UTC)(Zulu) of the image acquisition. UTC is assumed to be the time zone designator to express the time of day.

TGTID.Name: Target Identifier
TGTID.Description: The identification of the primary target consisting of ten characters of Basic Encyclopedia (BE) identifier, followed by five characters of facility OSUFFIX, followed by the two character country code as specified in FIPS PUB 10-4.

IID2.Name: Image Identifier 2
IID2.Description: The identification of additional information about the image.

ISCLAS.Name: Image Security Classification
ISCLAS.Description: The classification level of the image, including all sub segments.

ISCLSY.Name: Image Security Classification System
ISCLSY.Description: The national or multinational security system used to classify the image. Country Codes per FIPS PUB 10-4 shall be used to indicate national security systems. The designator 'XN' is for classified data generated by a component using NATO security system marking guidance. This code is outside the FIPS 10-4 document listing, and was selected to not duplicate that document's existing codes. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no security classification system applies to the image.

ISCODE.Name: Image Codewords
ISCODE.Description: The security compartments associated with the image. Values include one or more of the digraphs. Multiple entries shall be separated by a single space: The selection of a relevant set of codewords is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no codewords apply to the image.

ISCTLH.Name: Image Control and Handling
ISCTLH.Description: The additional security control and/or handling instructions (caveats) associated with the image. Values include digraphs. The digraph may indicate single or multiple caveats. The selection of a relevant caveat(s) is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no additional control and handling instructions apply to the image.

ISREL.Name: Image Releasing Instructions
ISREL.Description: A list of country and/or multilateral entity codes to which countries and/or multilateral entities the image is authorized for release. Valid items in the list are one or more country codes as found in FIPS PUB 10-4 separated by a single space. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no image release instructions apply.

ISDCTP.Name: Image Declassification Type
ISDCTP.Description: The indicator of the type of security declassification or downgrading instructions which apply to the image.

Values.DE: Declassify upon occurrence of an event
Values.GD: Downgrade to a specified level on a specific date
Values.GE: Downgrade to a specified level upon occurrence of an event
Values: No image security declassification or downgrading instructions

ISDCDT.Name: Image Declassification Date
ISDCDT.Description: The date on which an image is to be declassified if the value of ISDCTP is 'DD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no image declassification date applies.

ISDCXM.Name: Image Declassification Exemption
ISDCXM.Description: The reason the image is exempt from automatic declassification if the value of ISDCTP is 'X'. Valid values are X1 to X8 and X251 to X259. X1 to X8 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-202b(1) to (8) for material exempt from the 10-year rule. X251 to X259 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-301a(1) to (9) for permanently valuable material exempt from the 25-year declassification system. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that an image declassification exemption does not apply.

ISDG.Name: Image Downgradee
ISDG.Description: The classification level to which a image is to be downgraded if the values of ISDCTP are 'GD' or 'GE'.

Values: Image security downgrading does not apply

ISDGDT.Name: Image Downgrade Date
ISDGDT.Description: The date on which an image is to be downgraded if the value of ISDCTP is 'GD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that an image security downgrading date does not apply.

ISCLTX.Name: Image Classification Text
ISCLTX.Description: The additional information about image classification to include identification of a declassification or downgrading event if the values in ISDCTP are 'DE' or 'GE'. It may also be used to identify multiple classification sources and/or any other special handling rules. Values are user defined free text. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that additional information about image classification does not apply.

ISCATP.Name: Image Classification Authority Type
ISCATP.Description: The type of authority used to classify the image.

Values: Image classification authority type does not apply

ISCAUT.Name: Image Classification Authority
ISCAUT.Description: The classification authority for the image dependent upon the value in ISCATP. Values are user defined free text which should contain the following information: original classification authority name and position or personal identifier if the value in Image Classification Authority Type is O; title of the document or security classification guide used to classify the image if the value in Image Classification Authority Type is D; and Derive-Multiple if the image classification was derived from multiple sources and the value of the ISCATP field is M. In the latter case, the image originator will maintain a record of the sources used in accordance with existing security directives. One of the multiple sources may also be identified in Image Classification Text if desired. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no image classification authority applies.

ISCRSN.Name: Image Classification Reason
ISCRSN.Description: The reason for classifying the image. Valid values are A to G. These correspond to the reasons for original classification per E.O. 12958, Section 1.5.(a) to (g). If this field contains an space, it shall imply that no image classification reason applies.

ISRDT.Name: Image Security Source Date
ISRDT.Description: The date of the source used to derive the classification of the image. In the case of multiple sources, the date of the most recent source shall be used. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that an image security source date does not apply.

ISCTLN.Name: Image Security Control Number
ISCTLN.Description: A valid security control number associated with the image. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no image security control number applies.

ENCRYP.Name: Encryption Status
ENCRYP.Description: The value zero until such time as this specification is updated to define the use of other values.

ISORCE.Name: Image Source
ISORCE.Description: The description of the source of the image. If the source of the data is classified, then the description shall be preceded by the classification, including codeword(s). If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no image source data applies.

NROWS.Name: Number of Significant Rows in Image
NROWS.Description: The total number of rows of significant pixels in the image. When the product of the values of the NPPBV field and the NBPC field is greater than the value of the NROWS field (NPPBV * NBPC > NROWS), the rows indexed with the value of the NROWS field to (NPPBV * NBPC) minus 1 shall contain fill data. NOTE: Only the rows indexed 0 to the value of the NROWS field minus 1 of the image contain significant data. The pixel fill values are determined by the application.

NCOLS.Name: Number of Significant Columns in Image
NCOLS.Description: The total number of columns of significant pixels in the image. When the product of the values of the NPPBV field and the NBPC field is greater than the value of the NROWS field (NPPBV * NBPC > NROWS), the columns indexed with the value of the NROWS field to (NPPBV * NBPC) minus 1 shall contain fill data. NOTE: Only the columns indexed 0 to the value of the NROWS field minus 1 of the image contain significant data. The pixel fill values are determined by the application.

PVTYPE.Name: Pixel Value Type
PVTYPE.Description: The type of computer representation used for the value for each pixel for each band in the image. The data bits of INT and SI values shall appear in the file in order of significance, beginning with the MSB and ending with the LSB. Except when the data is JPEG 2000 compressed, INT and SI data types shall be limited to 8, 12, 16, 32, or 64-bits (see field NBPP). R values shall be represented according to IEEE 32 or 64-bit floating point representation (IEEE 754). C values shall be represented with the Real and Imaginary parts, each represented in IEEE 32 or 64- bit floating point representation (IEEE 754) and appearing in adjacent four or eight-byte blocks, first Real, then Imaginary. B (bi-level) pixel values shall be represented as single bits with binary value 1 or 0.

IREP.Name: Image Representation
IREP.Description: The processing required in order to display an image. This field should be used in conjunction with the IREPBAND field to interpret the processing required to display each band in the image.

Values.RGB: Red, green, or blue true color
Values.YCbCr601: Compressed in the ITU-R Recommendation BT.601-5 color space

ICAT.Name: Image Category
ICAT.Description: This field shall contain a valid indicator of the specific category of image, raster or grid data. The specific category of an IS reveals its intended use or the nature of its collector. This field should be used in conjunction with the ISUBCAT field to interpret the significance of each band in the image.

ABPP.Name: Actual Bits-Per-Pixel Per Band
ABPP.Description: The number of significant bits for the value in each band of each pixel without compression. Even when the image is compressed, ABPP contains the number of significant bits per pixel that were present in the image before compression. This field shall be less than or equal to Number of Bits Per Pixel (field NBPP). The number of adjacent bits within each NBPP is used to represent the value. These representation bits shall be left justified or right justified within the bits of the NBPP bits field, according to the value in the PJUST field. For example, if 11-bit pixels are stored in 16 bits, this field shall contain 11 and NBPP shall contain 16. The default number of significant bits to be used is the value contained in NBPP.

PJUST.Name: Pixel Justification
PJUST.Description: This field indicates whether the significant bits are left justified (L) or right justified (R). Nonsignificant bits in each pixel shall contain the binary value 0. Right justification is recommended.

ICORDS.Name: Image Coordinate Representation
ICORDS.Description: The type of coordinate representation used for providing an approximate location of the image in the Image Geographic Location field (IGEOLO). The default Geodetic reference system is WGS84. If no coordinate system is identified, the space shall be used.

Values.U: UTM expressed in Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) form

IGEOLO.Name: Image Geographic Location
IGEOLO.Description: The field, when present, shall contain an approximate geographic location which is not intended for analytical purposes (e.g., targeting, mensuration, distance calculation); it is intended to support general user appreciation for the image location (e.g., cataloguing). The representation of the image corner locations is specified in the ICORDS field. The locations of the four corners of the (significant) image data shall be given in image coordinate order: (0,0), (0, MaxCol), (MaxRow, MaxCol), (MaxRow, 0). MaxCol and MaxRow shall be determined from the values contained, respectively, in the NCOLS field and the NROWS field. MaxCol = is equal to the value contained in the NCOLS field minus 1 (MaxCol = NCOLS -1). This field shall be omitted if the value of the ICORDS field is BCS Space.

NICOM.Name: Number of Image Comments
NICOM.Description: The valid number of ICOM field(s) that follow to be used as free text image comments.

ICOM<NICOM>.Name: Image Comment
ICOM<NICOM>.Description: The field (ICOM1 to ICOMn), when present, shall contain free-form text. They are intended for use as a single comment block and should be used that way.  If the image comment is classified, it shall be preceded by the classification, including codeword(s). This field shall be omitted if the value in the NICOM field is 0.

IC.Name: Image Compression
IC.Description: The code indicating the form of compression used in representing the image data.

COMRAT.Name: Compression Rate Code
COMRAT.Description: A code indicating the compression rate for the image.

NBANDS.Name: Number of Bands
NBANDS.Description: The number of data bands within the specified image. This field and the IREP field are interrelated and independent of the IMODE field. The corresponding values for the IREP and NBANDS fields are NODISPLY, 0 to 9; MONO, 1; RGB, 3; RGB/LUT, 1; YCbCr601, 3; NVECTOR, 0 to 9; POLAR, 2; VPH, 2; MULTI, 0, 2 to 9; and zero  for multiple band images or matrices with greater than 9 bands.

XBANDS.Name: Number of Multispectral Bands
XBANDS.Description: The number of bands or data points comprising the multiple band image. Otherwise this field shall be omitted if the value of the NBANDS field is 1 to 9.

IREPBAND<NBANDS>.Name: Band Representation
IREPBAND<NBANDS>.Description: The processing required to display the band of the image with regard to the general image type as recorded in the IREP field. The significance of each band in the image can be derived from the combination of the ICAT, and ISUBCAT fields.

ISUBCAT<NBANDS>.Name: Band Subcategory
ISUBCAT<NBANDS>.Description: The purpose of this field is to provide the significance of the bands of the image with regard to the specific category (ICAT field) of the overall image.

IFC<NBANDS>.Name: Band Image Filter Condition
IFC<NBANDS>.Description: This field shall contain the value N (to represent none). Other values are reserved for future use.

IMFLT<NBANDS>.Name: Band Standard Image Filter Code
IMFLT<NBANDS>.Description: This field is reserved for future use. It shall be filled with spaces.

NLUTS<NBANDS>.Name: Number of LUTS for the Image Band
NLUTS<NBANDS>.Description: The number of LUTs associated with the band of the image. LUTs are allowed only if the value of the PVTYPE field is INT or B.

NELUT<NBANDS>.Name: Number of LUT Entries for the Image Band
NELUT<NBANDS>.Description: The number of entries in each of the LUTs for the image band. This field shall be omitted if the value in NLUTSn is zero.

LUTD<NLUTS<NBANDS>>.Name: Image Band LUT
LUTD<NLUTS<NBANDS>>.Description: The data defining the LUT for the image band. Each entry in the LUT is composed of one byte, ordered from MSB to LSB, representing a binary value from zero to 255.

ISYNC.Name: Image Sync code
ISYNC.Description: This field is reserved for future use. Do Not Use.

IMODE.Name: Image Mode
IMODE.Description: The method Image Pixels are stored in the NITF file.

NBPR.Name: Number of Blocks Per Row
NBPR.Description: The number of image blocks in a row of blocks in the horizontal direction. If the image consists of only a single block, this field shall contain the value one.

NBPC.Name: Number of Blocks Per Column
NBPC.Description: The number of image blocks in a column of blocks in the vertical direction. If the image consists of only a single block, this field shall contain the value one.

NPPBH.Name: Number of Pixels Per Block Horizontal
NPPBH.Description: The number of pixels horizontally in each block of the image. It shall be the case that the product of the values of the NBPR field and the NPPBH field is greater than or equal to the value of the NCOLS field. When NBPR is '0001', setting the NPPBH value to '0000' designates that the number of pixels horizontally is specified by the value in NCOLS.

NPPBV.Name: Number of Pixels Per Block Vertical
NPPBV.Description: The number of pixels vertically in each block of the image. It shall be the case that the product of the values of the NBPC field and the NPPBV field is greater than or equal to the value of the NCOLS field. When NBPR is '0001', setting the NPPBH value to '0000' designates that the number of pixels vertically is specified by the value in NCOLS.

NBPP.Name: Number of Bits Per Pixel Per Band
NBPP.Description: The number of storage bits used for the value from each component of a pixel vector. The value in this field always shall be greater than or equal to Actual Bits Per Pixel (ABPP). For example, if 11-bit pixels are stored in 16 bits, this field shall contain 16 and Actual Bits Per Pixel shall contain 11. If IC = C3, M3, C5, M5, or I1 this field shall contain the value 8 or the value 12. If IC = C1, this field shall contain the value 1. If IC = C8 or M8, this field shall contain the number of bits of precision (01-38) used in the JPEG 2000 compression of the data.

IDLVL.Name: Image Display Level
IDLVL.Description: The value that indicates the display level of the image relative to other displayed file components in a composite display.

IALVL.Name: Attachment Level
IALVL.Description: The value that indicates the attachment level of the image.

ILOC.Name: Image Location
ILOC.Description: The image location is the location of the first pixel of the first line of the image. The image location offset from the ILOC or SLOC value of the segment to which the image is attached or from the origin of the CCS when the image is unattached (IALVL contains 000). A row or column value of 00000 indicates no offset. Positive row and column values indicate offsets down and to the right while negative row and column values indicate offsets up and to the left.

IMAG.Name: Image Magnification
IMAG.Description: The magnification (or reduction) factor of the image relative to the original source image. Decimal values are used to indicate magnification, and decimal fraction values indicate reduction. For example, '2.30' indicates the original image has been magnified by a factor of '2.30'. while '0.5' indicates the original image has been reduced by a factor of 2. The default value is 1.0, indicating no magnification or reduction. In addition, the reductions can be represented as reciprocals of any non-negative integer: /2 (for 1/2), /3 (for 1/3), /4 (for 1/4), /5 (for 1/5), through /999 (for 1/999). The values are left justified and BCS spaces (0x20) filled to the right.

UDIDL.Name: User Defined Image Data Length
UDIDL.Description: A value of zeros shall denote that no TRE are included in the UDID field. If a TRE exists, the field shall contain the sum of the length of all the TREs appearing in the UDID field plus 3 bytes. If a TRE is too long to fit in the UDID field or the IXSHD field, it shall be put in the TRE overflow DES with DESID set to the value TRE_OVERFLOW.

UDOFL.Name: User Defined Overflow
UDOFL.Description: The sequence number of the DES into which they overflow.

UDID.Name: User Defined Overflow Data
UDID.Description: The user-defined TRE data. The length of this field shall be the value contained by the UDHDL field minus 3 bytes.

IXSHDL.Name: Image Extended Subheader Data Length
IXSHDL.Description: A value of zeros shall denote that no TRE are included in the IXSHD field. If a TRE exists, the field shall contain the sum of the length of all the TREs appearing in the IXSHD field plus 3 bytes. If a TRE is too long to fit in the UDID field or the IXSHD field, it shall be put in the TRE overflow DES with DESID set to the value TRE_OVERFLOW.

IXSOFL.Name: Image Extended Subheader Overflow
IXSOFL.Description: The sequence number of the DES into which they overflow.

IXSHD.Name: Image Extended Subheader Data
IXSHD.Description: The controlled TRE data. The length of this field shall be the value contained by the IXSHDL field minus 3 bytes.

Compression.Name: Compression Parameters
Compression.Description: This field is used to describe a variety of compression stream parameters.

Layers.Name: Quality Layers
Layers.Description: The number of J2K quality layers present.

Levels.Name: Pyramid Levels
Levels.Description: The number of wavelet decomposition levels (i.e. pyramids) present.

Order.Name: Progression Order
Order.Description: The four character identifiers have the following interpretation: L=layer; R=resolution; C=component (i.e. band); P=position. The first character in the identifier refers to the index which progresses most slowly while the last refers to the index which progresses most quickly.

Reversible.Name: Compression Quality
Reversible.Description: This value specifies if the compression is is considered lossless or lossy.  If true, then the compression is lossless, if false, then the compression lossy.

Type.Name: Compression Type
Type.Description: The type of image compression used.

UseEPH.Name: EPH Markers
UseEPH.Description: This value specifies whether markers for the end of each packet header (EPH) is used.

UsePrecincts.Name: Precincts Used
UsePrecincts.Description: This value specifies whether or not precinct dimensions are supplied.

UseSOP.Name: SOP Markers
UseSOP.Description: This value specifies whether markers for the start of each packet header (SOP) is used.

UseYCC.Name: YCrCb Color Space
UseYCC.Description: This value specifies whether color values have been coverted from RGB to Luminance-Chrominance conversion.
